concept: FSx for Lustre: HPC file system with S3 integration
tests: Choosing a shared file system for HPC with sub-millisecond latency, hundreds of GB/s and an S3 link.
expected: Amazon FSx for Lustre — a parallel file system for HPC/ML, massive throughput, native S3 integration (data repository). Triggers: "HPC", "hundreds of GB/s", "sub-millisecond", "integrated with S3".
why_not: EFS doesn't reach Lustre-level throughput; FSx for Windows — SMB; EBS io2 Block Express — block storage for one instance, not a shared file system.
